uncited: An approximation of soft shadows for volumetric sources.
Instead of traditional shadow maps, it represents rays towards the light source as a single cone.
The blocking contribution of the object inside this cone is estimated by accumulating opacity, using the same mipmapping mechanism as eye-ray traversal to approximate cone integration.
The resulting opacity value represents the amount of occlusion.
